cands.name: Scott Stadthagen

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Republican state representative for Alabama House District 9 (Hartselle) since 2018. Former owner of Hagen Homes, a custom home-building business. House Majority Leader from January 2023 until he stepped down in February 2026. Elected chair of the Alabama Republican Party on March 7, 2026.
cands.gaps: We could not find where he was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. We found no statements or actions from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, slowing growth or land conservation, immigration or H-1B, gun laws, abortion, school choice or teacher pay, or police pay. We did not find what became of his 2023 bill on Chinese land ownership. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2026, and he did not complete its candidate survey. We found no documented controversies or foreign ties in the pages reviewed.

qual.background: State representative since 2018 and House Majority Leader from 2023 to 2026. Before that he owned Hagen Homes, a custom home-building business, from 2005 to 2018, and chaired the Hartselle Area Chamber of Commerce.
qual.why: Several terms of legislative service plus chamber leadership as Majority Leader place him in the high range. Business ownership adds to the fit. Committee seats were not counted.

land-for-floridians.evidence: Filed HB379, the "Alabama Property Protection Act," in April 2023 to prevent Chinese ownership of Alabama property. The press release says it would be heard in a House committee; the pages do not say what happened to it.
